task.title: Run the complete A1/residual/A2/causal component crossover on both canonical benchmarks

authority.owner_clarification: Run all five requested component combinations at every budget on both setups, then diagnose margins/ranks and develop a public-development-calibrated A2 replacement.

truth_status.freeze_rule: Write and hash the complete 44-cell prediction artifact before either truth source is loaded by the runner.
truth_status.claim_limit: The crossover diagnoses component compatibility; a calibrated replacement requires a separately frozen method and fresh blind target updates for confirmation.

proposal_families.a1: Pinned public Alpaca affine lens; full-vocabulary ranking with stable token-ID tie break.
proposal_families.residual_affine: Existing clean cut-4 affine inverse; full-vocabulary cosine ranking with stable token-ID tie break.
proposal_families.a1_residual_union: Alternate A1 and residual-affine ranked IDs at each rank, A1 first, deduplicate, and continue until the fixed budget is filled.

selector_families.a2_fixed_budget: Simulate all K candidates through the public prefix using the greedy reconstructed prefix; score with historical centered cosine; compute K times softmax winner probability; accept only at the historical threshold 2.0, otherwise abstain and stop the suffix. The original A1-confidence fast path and progressive tiers are excluded from this symmetric fixed-budget selector and retained separately in the strict historical baseline.
selector_families.causal: Simulate all K candidates through the public prefix using the greedy reconstructed prefix; choose maximum uncentered cosine; break ties by candidate order; never abstain.

method_id_rule: Append _k8, _k16, _k32, or _k64 to each method prefix. residual_affine_causal_k16 is the existing causal_public_surrogate_k16 method and is recorded under that established ID.

primary_hypothesis.dominance_rule: PASS only if clean correct tokens exceed 2096 while historical correct tokens are at least 13741, or historical correct tokens exceed 13741 while clean correct tokens are at least 2096.

required_diagnostics: true-token rank and recall at K=8,16,32,64 for A1, residual-affine, and union proposals
A2 centered-cosine winner margin, normalized winner confidence, coverage, selective accuracy, and first-abstention position
causal uncentered-cosine winner margin and accuracy conditional on true-token inclusion
proposal exclusion versus selector error attribution
end-to-end accuracy, exact-record rate, paired record bootstrap intervals, phase timing, simulations, and peak memory

calibrated_a2_followup.starts_after: The complete fixed crossover and diagnostics are frozen and reported.
calibrated_a2_followup.development_only: Fit thresholds or a routing model only on disjoint public auxiliary records and public development updates; target benchmark truth is forbidden for fitting or model selection.
features_allowed: centered-cosine top1-top2 margin normalized within the candidate set
calibrated_a2_followup.confirmation: Evaluate the frozen calibrated method on both canonical setups for comparability and on fresh unavailable target updates for the blind claim.

stopping_rule: Run all 44 cells once with frozen code. Preserve failures. Do not promote the most favorable secondary budget to the preregistered primary claim.
